resources.string: Updates are checked when the app opens.
The update is ready to install.
Could not get the update. Check your connection and try again.
Could not open the installer. Check your device installation settings.
Version %1$s has been verified. Install it? The first time, allow installation from this app, return, and tap again.
Check that the same code appears on your Quest.
3D photos taken on Galaxy appear here. They remain in your gallery.
Add 3D photos taken on Galaxy to your gallery, then refresh.
Wait for a Quest or TV on the same Wi-Fi network
Quest connected · Choose a photo on Quest
Open Okuyuki on your Quest or TV and select your phone
Turn on to view photos on Quest or TV.
If your phone is not found
Enter the following address on your Quest or TV.
Viewed photos are cached temporarily on Quest and removed when you exit. Nothing is stored on the TV. No cloud service is used.
Waiting stops automatically after 10 minutes without a connection.
Alpha · Physical device testing is incomplete. Use a trusted home Wi-Fi network or phone hotspot.
Choose this photo on Quest to view it in 3D.
Enjoy photos from your phone on a Quest or TV on the same network.
Allow photo access to see supported 3D photos from your gallery in the library.
Connect your phone and your Quest or TV to the same Wi-Fi and turn on waiting in the Connect tab. Check the code shown before allowing the connection.
Loaded photos and videos from your gallery
Showing selected photos and videos only · Change photo access to see more
Could not read photos. Refresh to try again.
Could not start waiting. Open the app and try again.
Could not start connection. Check Wi-Fi.
Discovery failed. Enter the address shown here on your Quest or TV.
Preview photos, videos, and Osmo 360 footage
Could not open the photo. Choose a stitched 2:1 360° photo.
Turn on waiting in the Connect tab to share.
Sharing a 360° photo. Open it on your Quest.
Could not share. Check that waiting is on and the photo is 64 MB or smaller.
Choose a stitched 360° photo or MP4 video, or an Osmo 360 LRF. Direct OSV preview is experimental.
Could not play this video. Choose a supported stitched MP4.
Experimental approximation. Drag to look around. Lens calibration is not applied, so seams may be misaligned.
Could not play this file. Choose an Osmo 360 LRF file.
Choose an LRF or OSV file.
Sharing a 360° video. Open it on Quest.
Could not share video. Check the connection, size (up to 256 GiB), and that the file is seekable on this device.
Experimental direct playback. Lens calibration was not found, so misalignment and seams may occur.
Could not play this OSV. The device may not support two simultaneous 4K HEVC streams.
Experimental lens-calibrated preview. Alignment may vary by recording mode.
Rotation is smoothed using matched frame timestamps. Stabilization switches off if a frame cannot be matched.
Stabilization was switched off because the frame and attitude timestamps could not be matched.
Check that the same code appears on your TV.
No photos or videos to show
Add photos or videos to your gallery, then refresh. Everything here can be shown on a TV.
TV connected · Choose photos with the TV remote
Open Okuyuki TV on an LG TV and connect it to this phone. The first time, choose Allow on the TV screen.
Turn on the switch above to open Okuyuki TV on your TV from here.
TVs you open from the Connect tab appear here
Tap Show on TV to see this on your TV.
Open Okuyuki TV from the Connect tab to watch this on your TV.
No TVs found. Turn on the TV and connect it to the same Wi-Fi as this phone.
Could not search for TVs. Check Wi-Fi.
Turn on Connect to Quest or TV first.
Choose Allow on the TV screen.
Could not connect to the TV. Check that it is on and connected to Wi-Fi.
Enter the TV\'s IP address in the form 192.168.1.20.
Could not reach the TV. Check that it is on and on the same Wi-Fi.
The TV\'s certificate has changed. Remove this TV in Settings, then try again.
The TV did not allow the connection. Try again and choose Allow on the TV screen.
Okuyuki TV does not seem to be installed on the TV. Install it first.
Could not open Okuyuki TV on the TV.
Could not open Okuyuki TV on the TV (%1$s).
The TV did not respond. Try again.
The connection to the TV was lost. Try again.
